rules.rationale: Advanced frameProps retain final precedence unless a chart documents why it must compose an owned renderer or layout prop afterward.

evidence.note: The original final-property rule misclassified documented chart-owned renderer and overlay composition after frameProps.
Review required the precedence explanation to be attached to the frameProps spread and first override.

rules.rationale: Production examples should model package-family imports so consumers do not accidentally widen their entry graph.

evidence.note: The linked histogram example imported coordination APIs through the broad root entry despite their existing semiotic/ai subpath. Moved those APIs to semiotic/ai while retaining chart family imports.

rules.rationale: Literal hover coordinates are invalid when an automatic grouped-chart legend changes the drawable plot dimensions.

evidence.note: Review limited grouped-chart and literal-pointer correlation to the same function scope.

rules.rationale: Published ESM chunks merge many modules, so a module-scope statement a bundler cannot prove pure (displayName assignments, plugin registration, prototype mixins, un-annotated React factories) pins its component and everything it references into every consumer bundle that touches the chunk.

evidence.note: Module-scope displayName, registerXYPlugin, and provideMarginalGraphics statements retained the chart for every consumer of its published chunk; pure initializers plus render-time registration cut the tree-shaken semiotic/xy Scatterplot import from 150 to 123 KB gzip (Rolldown with splitting).

The attachUpdateResultStore prototype mixin and a lowered static class field ran at module scope, so any import touching the XY frame chunk retained the whole store; replaced with a method-only base class and a module constant.
